notes: This contract directly traces HLAupdatesSent to its pinned standard MIM entry and IEEE 1516.1 clause 11.4.1. Installed-package runs are bounded provider evidence, not proof of provider-independent behavior or conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard MIM declares HLAupdatesSent as an HLAcount updated periodically according to HLAsetTiming.HLAreportPeriod and defines it as the total number of times the Update Attribute Values service has been successfully invoked by the joined federate, rather than the number of instance attribute values updated. The scenario checks zero before application updates, three after three successful invocations including two updates to the same object, five after two further invocations while periodic reporting is enabled, and the unchanged final direct value after periodic reporting is disabled.
